desc: Select the KMP prefix-function approach on reversed(S) and scan S to find the longest palindromic suffix.

Implement the complete Python solution: read S as bytes, set R = S[::-1], compute the KMP prefix function pi for R, then scan S maintaining q (longest prefix of R that is a suffix of the scanned part) without resetting after a full match at the end; let k = q and print S + S[:n-k][::-1].
Verify edge cases and performance: n=1, S already a palindrome, no longer palindromic suffix, all same characters, and n=500000.
